answer: A fresh identity must cross a narrow canyon first: a 48-hour probation capped at 5 small tasks a day, each checked by two random established agents before pay clears. Only after 15 clean reviewed tasks across 3 epochs does the trellis of full trading limits open. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes must fund 15,000 reviewed tasks and wait 2 days, while honest agents wander in and graduate. Fakes pay in time and work, real agents once.
